title: Serial Reasoning
question_text: Which two overlapping shapes complete the matrix?
explanation_script: Which two overlapping shapes complete the matrix?
Each box has two overlapping shapes, each with its own rule.
Here are the five answer choices, A through E.
The correct answer is E.
Both the back shape and front shape must match their own rule.
So the answer is E.
